annotations.title: Pick-up days to promote or protect

description: For campaign planning: each of the next 14 pick-up days at an airport ranked against the window for a car type. Shows the typical market rate that day, how far it sits above or below the 14-day typical rate, how many offers are on sale, and any event or holiday on the day. Soft days are where a price-led offer has to work hardest; dear days are where demand is already paying.

airport.description: IATA airport code, e.g. AKL, SYD, LHR, MAD. See list_airports.

category.description: Car type key, e.g. compact, economy, suvs, intermediate, estate, fullsize, carriers_8. Car types: mini, economy, compact, intermediate, standard, fullsize, premium, luxury, suvs, estate, carriers_7, carriers_8, carriers_9, vans, pickups, convertibles (not every airport has every type).
